key.category.pingforit.name: Ping For It
settings.pingforit.title: Ping For It Configuration
settings.pingforit.server_settings.valid: Correct the highlighted server value. Inventory values must use their allowed range and multiplier grid.
settings.pingforit.server_settings.confi: Discard unsaved server changes and collapse this section?
settings.pingforit.ping_volume.tooltip:
Local ping-sound volume.
Decrease: quieter alerts; 0 mutes them.
Increase: louder alerts; other players' volume is unchanged.
settings.pingforit.ping_distance.tooltip:
Local native and Precise capture range for the next hold; native tracing also has a separate cap. Optional distant traces keep their own range.
Decrease: select closer targets.
Increase: allow farther candidates; server acceptance range is unchanged.
settings.pingforit.item_icon_visible.too:
Item-icon presentation for markers.
Off: use the ordinary ping icon.
On: show an item icon when authorized item data is available.
settings.pingforit.direction_indicator_v:
Screen-edge guidance to off-screen markers.
Off: hide direction indicators.
On: show indicators pointing toward off-screen markers.
settings.pingforit.mark_transparent_bloc:
Block-shape selection for the next hold; not a general opacity filter.
Off: use Minecraft's visual shapes.
On: use outline shapes, including selectable decorations without collision.
settings.pingforit.mark_blacklisted_targ:
Entity target selection for the next hold; unrelated to block display lists.
Off: skip blacklisted entities.
On: include them as candidates; spectators remain excluded.
settings.pingforit.mark_fluids.tooltip:
Fluid target selection for the next hold.
Off: ignore fluids in the selection ray.
On: include fluids as selectable hits.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.tool:
Marker author information, not information about the target player.
Hold: show name and head while the player-list key is held. Always: keep them visible.
Compact: put the head beside the distance. Disabled: hide author information.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.hold:
Show the marker author's name and head while "%s" (%s) is held.
Release the key to hide the author information.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.disa:
Hide the marker author's name and head.
The target name and distance remain visible.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.alwa:
Keep the marker author's name and head visible.
Uses an additional label below the marker.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.comp: Show the author's head beside the distance instead of a separate name label.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.toolt:
Team formatting of the verbose author label, not marker recoloring.
Full and Labels Only keep team formatting; Disabled and Ping Only remove it.
Marker colors follow Ping Type; target and distance text stay white.
Full has the same effect as Labels Only: keep team formatting on the verbose author label.
Marker colors still follow Ping Type; target and distance text stay white.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.disab:
Disabled has the same effect as Ping Only: remove team formatting from the verbose author label.
Marker colors still follow Ping Type; target and distance text stay white.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.ping_:
Ping Only has the same effect as Disabled: remove team formatting from the verbose author label.
It does not recolor markers; they follow Ping Type. Target and distance text stay white.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.label:
Labels Only has the same effect as Full: keep team formatting on the verbose author label.
Marker colors still follow Ping Type; target and distance text stay white.
settings.pingforit.ping_size.tooltip:
Local size of markers and direction indicators.
Decrease: smaller overlays cover less of the view.
Increase: larger overlays are more prominent but cover more of the view.
settings.pingforit.wheel_opacity.tooltip:
Selector underlay opacity for the next hold; labels have a separate control.
Decrease: reveal more of the world; 0 hides the underlay.
Increase: make the underlay more opaque.
Opacity of text-bearing selector frames and their labels; applies to the next hold.
Decrease: fade frames and text; 0 makes them invisible.
Increase: make frames and text more visible; the underlay is unchanged.
settings.pingforit.wheel_font_size.toolt:
Selector option-label text size for the next hold.
Decrease: use smaller option text.
Increase: use larger option text, which needs more space.
settings.pingforit.wheel_target_font_siz:
Selector target-label text size for the next hold.
Decrease: use smaller target text.
Increase: use larger target text, which needs more space.
settings.pingforit.reset_all.title: Reset all settings?
settings.pingforit.reset_all.message: Reset every client setting to its default? Server configuration is not reset.
settings.pingforit.reset_all.tooltip:
Reset every client preference, including remembered channels, after confirmation.
Does not reset server configuration; discards any unsent ordinary-server draft.
Protected files may prevent persistence.
settings.pingforit.wheel_hold_millis.too:
Ordinary hold required to open the selector; applies to the next press. Lowering this can also shorten the compatibility slice.
Decrease: open sooner; short taps have less time before opening.
Increase: wait longer before opening; the optional gesture shortcut remains independent.
settings.pingforit.cancel_half_cone_angl:
Aim cone for selecting your nearest own marker to unping; server ownership and activity checks still apply.
Decrease: require more precise aim.
Increase: include markers farther from the press direction; nearest distance still wins.
settings.pingforit.channel.tooltip:
Channel preference remembered for this server and sent when settings are saved.
Non-empty: exchange pings with players using the same channel.
Empty: use the server's default-channel policy; the placeholder is only a hint.
settings.pingforit.open_block_shape_blac: Save, Close & Open Block Shape Config...
Saves and closes Settings before opening the client config file. Edits to external lists take effect after restarting the client.
settings.pingforit.entity_block_render_m:
Entity-block outline sources; applies on the next render attempt, not to target selection.
All: built-in and registered optional sources. Compatible: built-in renderers and loader-aware models only.
VoxelShape Only: skip normal sources and use native shapes; the other modes fall back when no source renders.

For entity-block outlines, try built-in renderers and models plus registered optional geometry sources.
Can include more source geometry; native shape fallback remains when none renders. Applies on the next render attempt.

For entity-block outlines, try only built-in renderers and loader-aware models; skip optional geometry sources.
Native shape fallback remains when none renders. Applies on the next render attempt.

For entity-block outlines, skip normal geometry sources and use the native VoxelShape route.
This changes outline geometry, not target selection. Applies on the next render attempt.
Default policy for senders with an empty channel; named channels are unchanged.
Auto: same team context; unteamed players share a context. Global: all empty-channel players.
Team Only: require a team and use that context. Disabled: reject empty-channel creates.
settings.pingforit.player_tracking_enabl:
How newly requested player targets are represented by the server.
Off: normalize player targets to their current authoritative location.
On: retain player entity targets so their markers can follow movement.
settings.pingforit.ms_to_regenerate.tool:
Milliseconds to recover one create allowance; rate limit sets the burst allowance.
Decrease: allowances recover sooner; 0 disables the client courtesy gate, not an unconditional server bypass.
Increase: allowances recover more slowly.
settings.pingforit.rate_limit.tooltip:
Per-player burst allowance for marker creates, with recovery set by Regeneration Time.
Decrease: allow fewer burst creates; 0 disables rate checking rather than disabling pings.
Increase: allow more burst creates; recovery per allowance is unchanged.
settings.pingforit.sync_duration.tooltip:
Server lifetime frozen for newly created markers; local display time is separate. 0 is not a disable mode.
Decrease: new markers expire sooner on the server.
Increase: new markers remain active longer; existing expiry times do not change.
command.pingforit.channel.set.descriptio: set your channel, use "" for default channel
command.pingforit.channel.set.reject: Channel names are limited to a length of %s characters
settings.pingforit.long_press_compatibil:
Rapid-click and deferred-capture compatibility; enabling clears the gesture shortcut and Danger angle without restoring them later.
Off: use ordinary presses and any explicitly re-enabled gestures.
On: closely spaced clicks can form a virtual hold; a pending capture can retain one fresh press.

Adjacent-click gap used only in compatibility mode, capped at half the hold threshold.
Decrease: clicks must be closer together to continue a virtual hold.
Increase: allow wider gaps between adjacent clicks.
settings.pingforit.marker_display_durati:
Local display time for newly received markers; 0 follows each marker's frozen server duration.
Decrease: new markers disappear locally sooner.
Increase: new markers stay visible longer; server lifetime and existing markers are unchanged.
settings.pingforit.configuration_notice_:
Size of local target-selection toggle notices.
Decrease: smaller notices; 0 hides them without disabling the toggles.
Increase: larger notices cover more of the view.
settings.pingforit.server_status.permiss: You do not have permission to edit server settings.
settings.pingforit.server_status.ready: Server settings loaded. Changes are sent when you leave Settings.
settings.pingforit.server_status.draft: Unsaved server changes are retained across categories.
settings.pingforit.server_status.read_on: Server settings are read-only for you. The current values are shown.
settings.pingforit.reset_all.server_draf: This also discards the unsaved server-settings draft.
settings.pingforit.open_client_config.to:
Save local settings and send any valid ordinary-server draft, then close Settings and open the complete client file.
If saving or validation fails, the file is not opened.
External edits take effect only after restarting the client; reopening Settings does not reload the file.
settings.pingforit.presentation.whitelis:
Fallback for fields matching neither list, for the selected target type.
Off: use each unmatched field's manifest default.
On: deny unmatched fields; allow matches still beat block matches.
settings.pingforit.presentation.server.c: You can edit the server policy
You cannot edit the server policy
settings.pingforit.presentation.feedback: Invalid selector: use namespace:path with * wildcards
That selector is already in the list
The list is full (128 selectors maximum)
That selector is no longer in the list
You do not have permission to edit the server policy
The server did not answer; refresh and try again
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.e: No fields are available on this connection.
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.u: Fields are unknown until the server accepts the connection.
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.n: Configuring a field does not guarantee data: target type, timing, and permission still apply.
settings.pingforit.presentation.rule.all:
Toggle this exact field ID in the selected type's allow list.
Off: remove only that exact rule; wildcard allow rules may still apply.
On: allow this field ahead of block rules; permissions and child restrictions still apply.
settings.pingforit.presentation.rule.blo:
Toggle this exact field ID in the selected type's block list.
Off: remove only that exact rule; other rules and defaults still apply.
On: block the field unless any allow selector matches.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.mi: Current health of a living entity.
Maximum health of a living entity.
Registry ID of the item in a dropped item stack.
Stack size of a dropped item.
Whether an item icon is available.
Block state properties of the pinged block.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.cr: Kinetic rotation speed. Access depends on the selected target type and server rules.
Whether the kinetic block is connected to a network.
Whether the kinetic network is overstressed.
Current stress of the kinetic network.
Stress capacity of the kinetic network.
Available stress capacity of the kinetic network; may be negative when overstressed.
Contents summary of a Create inventory. Disabled by default.
Contents summary of a Create fluid tank. Disabled by default.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.pi: Item contents of the pinged inventory.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.gest:
Optional early opening for the next hold; compatibility forces this off and does not restore it.
Off: use ordinary long-press opening.
On: after holding your bound Ping key for the minimum physical time, move beyond the center deadzone to open early.

Minimum continuous physical hold before the enabled gesture shortcut can open; applies to the next hold. Ordinary long press is independent.
Decrease: movement can qualify sooner.
Increase: require a longer physical hold before movement can open early.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.dead:
Radial cancel-center and inventory side-intent distance; applies to the next hold. List distance starts at the panel's outer side frame, with a screen-edge fallback.
Decrease: smaller cancel center; side focus starts sooner.
Increase: larger cancel center; side focus requires more movement.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.stro:
Stroke before a pause or qualified turn can enter a submenu, and inventory side-navigation distance; applies to the next hold. List distance uses the same frame/edge origin without adding the deadzone.
Decrease: less movement before entry or side navigation can qualify.
Increase: require a longer stroke before entry or side navigation.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.dwel:
Pause after a qualifying stroke before submenu entry; applies to the next hold.
Decrease: enter sooner when pausing.
Increase: require a longer pause; qualified-turn entry is a separate path.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.root:
Root choices' visual distance from the center; applies to the next hold. Deadzone and entry stroke are unchanged.
Decrease: bring root choices inward.
Increase: spread root choices farther outward.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.subm:
Visual scale of every non-root radial menu, including item menus; applies to the next hold. Root distance and gesture thresholds are unchanged.
Decrease: make submenus more compact.
Increase: spread submenu choices farther apart.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.inve:
Inventory-panel width cap relative to the GUI viewport; applies to the next hold. Content and readable minima still apply.
Decrease: allow a narrower panel.
Increase: allow a wider panel; this is not a fixed width.

Inventory-panel height cap relative to the GUI viewport, not a fixed height; applies to the next hold. Content and readable minima still apply.
Decrease: allow a shorter panel, potentially showing fewer rows.
Increase: allow a taller panel, potentially showing more rows.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.hove:
Back navigation for the next hold.
Off: use the ordinary Back gesture.
On: require continuous Back focus for the configured dwell; leave and re-enter to return again.

Continuous Back focus required when hover return is enabled; applies to the next hold.
Decrease: return sooner after focusing Back.
Increase: require longer Back focus; no effect while hover return is off.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.show:
Pointer and active-option trail for the next hold; selection is unchanged.
Off: hide both trails.
On: draw their shared movement trail.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.redu:
Selector animation for the next hold; gesture timing and selection are unchanged.
Off: use normal selector animation.
On: reduce selector motion.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.cont:
Additional property and inventory-item Ping Type menus under Content; applies to the next hold. Whole-marker Ping Type is unchanged.
Off: selectable content commits directly as Attention.
On: offer an additional menu to choose the content's Ping Type.
settings.pingforit.budget_delay_notifica:
Administrator notices for sustained resource delays; WARN diagnostics remain enabled.
Off: fewer chat messages; delays are easier to miss.
On: shows which work is waiting, helping you choose a budget to adjust.
message.pingforit.budget_delay: [ping for it] Sustained budget delays in %s. Review server performance budgets or blacklists.
settings.pingforit.inventory.physical_sl:
Actual inventory slot reads per server tick, shared by preview and tracking.
Decrease: less work per tick; large containers may update more slowly.
Increase: more reading can progress per tick; server load may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.pending_mem:
Pending data memory for preview and tracking across the server.
Decrease: eases memory pressure; large containers and many targets may update more slowly.
Increase: retains more container data, reducing waits caused by memory shortages; memory use may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.display_byt:
Data size for one displayed item, limited by the frame size.
Decrease: smaller item payloads; complex item details may be simplified.
Increase: preserves more item details; each entry may use more data and processing.
settings.pingforit.inventory.frame_byte_:
Data that fits in one inventory packet.
Decrease: smaller packets; updates may need more fragments and item display size may be reduced.
Increase: more data fits per packet; individual packets may be heavier.
settings.pingforit.inventory.size_adjust: Display size lowered to %s to fit the %s inventory frame.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_per:
Interval for replenishing preview allowances.
Decrease: more frequent replenishment can reduce preview waits; processing and traffic may rise.
Increase: less frequent replenishment reduces overhead; previews may wait longer.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_max:
Item variant quota per player and preview period.
Decrease: less list processing and data; preview lists may omit item variants.
Increase: more variants can appear in previews; list processing and data may grow.

Inventory slot progress per player and preview period.
Decrease: less preview work per player; large-container previews may take longer.
Increase: a player's previews can progress further; server work may rise.

Inventory slot progress across the server per preview period.
Decrease: less total preview work; simultaneous previews may wait longer.
Increase: more preview work can progress together; server load may rise.

Concurrent preview requests per player.
Decrease: fewer active requests use resources; browsing many targets may wait longer.
Increase: more targets can be requested together; memory and processing may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_cli:
Preview data sent per player and preview period.
Decrease: less traffic per player; large previews may arrive more slowly.
Increase: more preview data can be sent per period; bandwidth use may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_glo:
Server-wide preview data per period and send-queue allowance.
Decrease: less total traffic and queued data; simultaneous previews may wait longer.
Increase: more preview data can be queued and sent; bandwidth and memory use may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_di:
Server inventory tracking; current player permissions and face-visible slots still apply.
Off: reuse tracking observations across faces only for proven equivalent views.
On: keep tracking observations separate by face.
Applies to the next scan; running scans finish with the previous setting.

Server inventory tracking; current player permissions and face-visible slots still apply.
Off: reuse tracking observations across players only for proven equivalent views.
On: keep tracking observations separate by player.
Applies to the next scan; running scans finish with the previous setting.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_pe:
Tracking allowance interval and pause after a complete inventory scan.
Decrease: more frequent replenishment and scans can reduce update waits; processing and traffic may rise.
Increase: less frequent replenishment and scans reduce overhead; changes may appear later.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_ma:
Active tracked item-variant selections on the same target.
Decrease: fewer selections use resources; fewer item variants can be tracked together.
Increase: more variants can stay tracked together; memory and update work may rise.

Inventory slot progress per target and tracking period.
Decrease: less work per target; large-container changes may appear later.
Increase: each target's scan can progress further; server work may rise.

Inventory slot progress across the server per tracking period.
Decrease: less total tracking work; many active targets may update more slowly.
Increase: more targets can make scan progress together; server load may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_st:
Change data sent per player and target each tracking period.
Decrease: less change traffic; busy containers may update more slowly.
Increase: more changes can be sent per period; bandwidth use may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_sn:
Snapshot fragment size and per-player snapshot total across targets each period.
Decrease: smaller fragments and less traffic; initial views and repairs may take longer.
Increase: more snapshot data can be sent per period; packets and bandwidth use may grow.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_gl:
Server-wide tracking data per period and send-queue allowance.
Decrease: less total traffic and queued data; busy targets may wait longer.
Increase: more tracking data can be queued and sent; bandwidth and memory use may rise.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_re:
Minimum interval between tracking repair requests.
Decrease: allows more frequent repairs and earlier recovery; repair traffic may rise.
Increase: fewer repeated requests reduce traffic; recovery may take longer.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_he:
Positive values set the interval between periodic tracking checks.
Decrease: more frequent checks can find inconsistencies sooner; overhead may rise.
Increase: fewer checks reduce overhead; inconsistencies may be found later.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_gr:
Window for smoothing server-wide tracking traffic.
Decrease: smaller short-term peaks; clustered updates may take longer to send.
Increase: clustered updates fit more easily into short bursts; traffic peaks may be larger.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.prec:
Live candidate capture interval while Precise is active; applies to the next hold.
Decrease: refresh candidates more often; 1 captures every tick and may do more capture work.
Increase: refresh less often; candidate changes can appear later.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.mi: Custom name of the pinged target.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.trai:
Retained trail points for the next hold.
Decrease: retain fewer points for a shorter possible trail.
Increase: retain more points for a longer possible trail when movement is sufficient.

Trail visibility only for the next hold; wheel, options, guides, and connector are unchanged.
Decrease: make the trail fainter; 0 hides it without changing history or selection.
Increase: make the trail more opaque.
settings.pingforit.double_click_danger_w:
Time between adjacent presses in a repeated Danger sequence; applies to the next press. The first tap is not delayed.
Decrease: require faster repeated presses.
Increase: allow slower repeated presses; qualifying repeats reuse the first target.
settings.pingforit.double_click_danger_a:
Allowed active-mouse turn from the first press for repeated Danger; applies to the next press. 0 disables it, and compatibility clears it to 0.
Decrease: require steadier aim; 0 turns the gesture off.
Increase: allow more mouse turn; qualifying repeats still use the first target.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.inve:
Inventory-list and item-menu release behavior; applies to the next hold.
Off: release follows ordinary commit or close behavior.
On: first release keeps it open; later taps commit, and holding cancels the selection without unpinging a marker.
settings.pingforit.scope.client.tooltip: Edit preferences on this client; server authority is unchanged.
settings.pingforit.scope.server.tooltip: View server settings; editing requires permission level 3. Ordinary changes are sent on final close; presentation rules use a separate immediate route.
settings.pingforit.navigation.back.toolt: Return to this scope's overview without sending the ordinary-server draft.
settings.pingforit.navigation.done.toolt: Save client settings, then send valid ordinary-server changes and close. Server application is not acknowledged.
settings.pingforit.presentation.server.t:
Server field rules for the selected target type; each edit is sent separately, not on Settings close.
Allow matches beat block matches; field permissions and data availability still apply.
Editing requires permission level 3; child restrictions are file-only.
settings.pingforit.presentation.target_t:
Choose which target type's rules to view and edit.
Switching types does not change policy or discard another list's typed text.
settings.pingforit.presentation.selector:
Enter a field-ID selector such as minecraft:entity.health or create:kinetic.*.
* matches within one namespace or path part, never across ':'; adapter IDs do not select their fields.
Typing does not apply a rule; use Add.
settings.pingforit.presentation.add.tool:
Send this selector to the selected type's current list now.
Successful adds clear only this list's unchanged input; errors keep the text.
settings.pingforit.presentation.remove.t:
Request removal of this selector from this list now.
Other matching selectors, whitelist-only mode, and defaults still apply.
Request a fresh server policy view without changing rules.
Retains typed input and the last known view; retry after a request times out.
settings.pingforit.presentation.advanced:
Show or hide selector lists and whitelist-only mode for this target type.
This changes only the editor view, not server policy.
settings.pingforit.category.client.displ: Choose local capture reach, marker display duration, icons, size, and author information. These do not change server range or lifetime.
settings.pingforit.category.client.selec: Choose whether capture includes outline-shaped blocks, blacklisted entities, and fluids. Changes apply to the next hold, not to block display lists.
settings.pingforit.category.client.wheel: Adjust wheel and inventory layout, text, opacity, trails, and motion for the next hold. Appearance does not replace gesture thresholds.
settings.pingforit.category.client.input: Tune opening, compatibility, repeated Danger presses, unping aim, navigation gestures, and content selection. Compatibility clears conflicting gesture choices.
settings.pingforit.category.client.chann: Choose a channel for this server and adjust local ping-sound volume and toggle-notice size. An empty channel uses server policy.
settings.pingforit.category.client.geome: Choose entity-block outline sources or save, close, and open the complete client file. External file edits require a client restart.
settings.pingforit.category.client.perfo: Set how often the active Precise branch captures live candidates. Shorter intervals refresh sooner but may do more capture work; applies to the next hold.
settings.pingforit.category.server.chann: Set server behavior for empty channels and newly requested player targets. Ordinary edits remain a draft until final close.
settings.pingforit.category.server.send_: Set each player's marker-create burst allowance and recovery interval. A zero rate limit disables rate checking, not pings.
settings.pingforit.category.server.marke: Set the server lifetime frozen for newly created markers. Existing expiry times and independent client display preferences do not change.
settings.pingforit.category.server.perfo: Control administrator delay notices and shared, preview, and tracking inventory budgets. Trade resource use against progress, delivery waits, and item detail.
settings.pingforit.category.server.serve: View and edit per-target-type field rules from this connection's catalog. Edits use a separate immediate server route and require permission level 3.
